DESCRIPTION OF SECURITIES TO BE REGISTERED</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href="#signatures">SIGNATURES</a></td></tr></table></div><div id="note"><h2 align="center">EXPLANATORY NOTE</h2>
<p>SVCV, Inc. (the <b>"Company"</b> or <b>"SVCV"</b>), previously known as SVCV Global and SVCV Company, is being developed as a consumer products, entertainment and intellectual property holding company. This registration statement is prepared in connection with the proposed registration of a class of the Company's securities under Section 12(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the <b>"Exchange Act"</b>).</p>
<p>Unless the context indicates otherwise, "we," "us," "our" and "Company" refer to SVCV, Inc.; "Parent" refers to The NEXROC Group Inc.; and "Manager" refers to BCKD Management Group L.P., a Delaware limited partnership.</p>
</div><div id="forward"><h2 align="center">FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS; RISK FACTOR SUMMARY</h2>
<p>This registration statement contains forward-looking statements concerning the Company's anticipated operations, acquisitions, licensing arrangements, financing, investments and business strategy. These statements are subject to risks and uncertainties, and actual results may differ materially from anticipated results. Forward-looking statements speak only as of their date, and the Company undertakes no obligation to update them except as required by applicable law.</p>
<ul><li>The Company is in development and has not established a meaningful operating track record.</li><li>Consumer demand, entertainment trends and intellectual property values can change rapidly.</li><li>Licensing revenues depend on enforceable rights, counterparties and commercial adoption.</li><li>Proposed acquisitions and financing may not be completed on acceptable terms.</li><li>Leverage and illiquid private investments may result in significant losses.</li><li>Cross-border operations may expose the Company to legal, currency, tax and regulatory risks.</li><li>The Company expects to rely on the Parent and third-party service providers for administrative support.</li></ul>
</div><div id="item1"><h2 align="center">ITEM 1. BUSINESS</h2>
<h3>Overview</h3>
<p>SVCV, Inc. is being developed as a diversified consumer, entertainment and intellectual property holding company. Its proposed core activities include the development, acquisition, ownership, licensing, marketing, distribution and sale of intellectual property and consumer products, including entertainment content and related merchandise. The Company may also pursue venture capital and private equity investments in businesses aligned with these activities.</p>
<h3>Planned Business Activities</h3>
<p>The Company intends to generate revenue through intellectual property licensing and royalties; consumer and retail sales; content production, advertising and events; subscriptions; distribution agreements; and, where appropriate, investment returns and profit distributions. It may evaluate strategic acquisitions, special purpose vehicles and other structured investment arrangements. Activities requiring regulatory authorization would be undertaken only subject to applicable approvals.</p>
<h3>Proposed Subsidiaries</h3>
<table border="1" cellpadding="4" cellspacing="0" width="100%"><tr><th>Proposed entity</th><th>Intended focus</th></tr><tr><td>SVCV Ventures</td><td>Venture capital, private equity and strategic investments</td></tr><tr><td>SVCV Content</td><td>Entertainment content, production, distribution and intellectual property licensing</td></tr><tr><td>The GoGoPaPa Company</td><td>Consumer products, brands, merchandising and retail distribution</td></tr></table>
<h3>Management and Administration</h3>
<p>The Company's proposed executive functions include a Chief Executive Officer, a Financial Officer and an Investment Officer. The Company expects to obtain back-office and middle-office support through its Parent and associated service arrangements. BCKD Management Group L.P. is identified as the Company's manager.</p>
<h3>Investment Strategy</h3>
<p>The Company's proposed investment activities focus principally on venture capital and private equity opportunities in consumer brands, entertainment, content and intellectual property. The Company may consider debt financing, sponsor capital, private placements and special purpose investment vehicles as potential sources of capital, subject to commercial conditions and applicable law.</p>
</div><div id="item1a"><h2 align="center">ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS</h2>
<p><b>Development-stage operations.</b> The Company is being developed and may incur operating losses or fail to execute its business plan.</p>
<p><b>Intellectual property.</b> Copyright, trademark, licensing, infringement and ownership disputes may impair revenues or result in substantial expenses.</p>
<p><b>Commercial concentration.</b> Revenue may depend on a limited number of brands, titles, distributors, customers or counterparties.</p>
<p><b>Acquisition and financing risks.</b> Planned acquisitions, venture investments and financing arrangements may be delayed, unavailable or unsuccessful.</p>
<p><b>Valuation and liquidity.</b> Private equity, venture investments and intellectual property may be difficult to value and may not be readily saleable.</p>
<p><b>Consumer and entertainment markets.</b> Changes in demand, platform policies, trends, technology and competition may adversely affect results.</p>
<p><b>Regulation and cross-border exposure.</b> Activities may be affected by laws governing consumer products, advertising, content, privacy, securities, taxation and international trade.</p>
<p><b>Reliance on affiliates.</b> Operational dependence on the Parent, the Manager and third-party service providers creates conflicts, continuity and execution risks.</p>
</div><div id="item2"><h2 align="center">ITEM 2. FINANCIAL INFORMATION</h2>
<p>The Company is being developed as a consumer, entertainment and intellectual property holding company. Its proposed financing sources include sponsor capital, private capital placements, debt syndication and special purpose investment vehicles. These financing approaches are strategic objectives and are not statements of capital already raised.</p>
<p>Potential operating revenue sources include consumer product sales, intellectual property licensing fees and royalties, content production and distribution, advertising, events, subscriptions and investment proceeds. The Company may pursue venture capital and private equity opportunities that complement its commercial operations.</p>
</div><div id="item4"><h2 align="center">ITEM 4. SECURITY OWNERSHIP OF CERTAIN BENEFICIAL OWNERS AND MANAGEMENT</h2>
<p>The NEXROC Group Inc. is identified as the sole parent and 100% owner of SVCV, Inc. BCKD Management Group L.P., a Delaware limited partnership, is identified as the Company's manager. The Company's ultimate beneficial ownership is dependent upon the ownership and control of its Parent.</p>
</div><div id="item7"><h2 align="center">ITEM 7. CERTAIN RELATIONSHIPS AND RELATED TRANSACTIONS</h2>
<p>The Company is wholly owned by The NEXROC Group Inc. and expects to obtain back-office and middle-office support from the Parent. BCKD Management Group L.P. serves as the identified management entity. These arrangements may involve related-party services, fees and allocations of personnel or other resources.</p>
</div><div id="item11"><h2 align="center">ITEM 11. DESCRIPTION OF SECURITIES TO BE REGISTERED</h2>
<p>The proposed class of securities for registration is the Company's ordinary shares. The rights attaching to the ordinary shares are governed by the Company's constitutional documents and applicable British Virgin Islands law.</p>
</div>
